purpose: Controlled laboratory traffic dataset for deployment-compatible detector development.
data_origin: Traffic genuinely executed inside the isolated project testbed.

separation_from_ciciot2023.dataset_a: Selected CICIoT2023 CSV feature representation used by Exp001-Exp009.
separation_from_ciciot2023.dataset_b: Separately generated controlled laboratory traffic used by Exp010.

ground_truth_rule: Ground truth originates from the controlled workload generator configuration and run identity, not from model predictions.
feature_generation_rule: Feature extraction must not consult ground-truth labels.
window_selection_rule: Packet windows must be selected independently of ground-truth class.
